title: Offline: privacy and responsible-gambling pages not precached, and /results?query shows the offline page though /results is cached
persona: User on slow 3G (400 kbps, 400 ms RTT, 4x CPU)
expected: All pages listed as public in sw.js open offline
actual: Cached in sl-pages-v2: only /, /results, /legal/terms (pages visited). Offline /legal/privacy and /results?x=1 returned the Offline page. Also activate handler deletes every cache except SHELL, so sl-pages-v2 is wiped on every SW update. Positives: /slate, /edges and /game/* offline show the offline page on both QA-OPEN and QA-PAYWALL, and no /slate, /edges, /game or /api entry exists in any cache (no paid data served).
suspected_area: public/sw.js: PUBLIC_PAGES not precached; ks.filter(k => k !== SHELL) deletes PAGES; !url.search rule
